title: T-3 storage round-trip covers put/get/delete/list on both SQL and KV backends
asA: developer configuring the storage backend on a new SingleCellObject
iWant: the shipped storage driver factory to round-trip put/get/delete/list on both SQL and KV backends
soThat: the applied project can elicit the backend at apply time and the shipped code path exercises both branches without code changes

acceptanceCriteria.description: createInMemoryDoStorage({backend: "sql"}) and createInMemoryDoStorage({backend: "kv"}) both round-trip put("k","v")->get("k"), delete("k") followed by get returning undefined, and list({prefix:"p/"}) returning a Map keyed by the prefix. driver.backend reports the chosen backend on each factory.
acceptanceCriteria.given: two storage drivers, one on each backend
acceptanceCriteria.when: put/get/delete/list operations are driven on each driver in turn
acceptanceCriteria.then: both round-trip identically and driver.backend reports the elicited answer
